name: Sprockhövel (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, blue and yellow in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Sprockhövel (leaves on yellow above crossed hammers on black).
history: By deed of 7 July 1980 the Regierungspräsident Arnsberg granted the city of Sprockhövel the right to bear a city flag and a city banner, described as yellow, blue and yellow striped 1:3:1 with the city shield in the middle of the blue stripe.
